steps.description: Read the task carefully — identify ALL required output sheets and their structure before writing any code

suggestions: Read instruction.md carefully and list ALL required output sheets by name before writing any code — missing a sheet causes total failure.
warnings: The task may require multiple sheets (e.g., 'Results', 'Dots', 'Summary'). If any required sheet is missing or empty the verifier will fail ALL tests for that sheet.

steps.description: Choose appropriate tool: pandas for data inspection, openpyxl for writing formulas and formatting
Load existing workbook or create a new one
Modify workbook — write Excel formulas to ALL required sheets

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ Use Excel formula strings (e.g., '=WILKS(A1)') rather than hardcoding Python-computed values.

suggestions: Write data and formulas to EVERY required output sheet identified in step 1 — an empty sheet fails all tests for that sheet.
Use Excel formula strings (e.g., '=IF(A1>B1, ...)', '=WILKS_FORMULA(...)') rather than computing values in Python.
warnings: Do not leave any required sheet empty or skip it — even a sheet with only structural headers must have data populated.

steps.description: Save workbook to the output .xlsx file
Recalculate all formulas using recalc.py (mandatory when formulas are used)
Verify recalc output and confirm ALL required sheets are populated with correct data

suggestions: After recalc, open the file with openpyxl data_only=True and verify each required sheet has data in the expected cells.
Check recalc.py JSON output for 'status: success' and 'total_errors: 0' before finishing.
warnings: Do not assume a sheet is populated just because you wrote formulas — verify actual cell values after recalculation.
